About HUYS LIGGERS 
HUYS LIGGERS is the specialist in heavy and complex steel structures made from profiles and sheet metal. We provide custom solutions to leading steel construction companies both domestically and internationally. Our beams-ranging from plate girders to hat beams-are found in commercial construction, industrial buildings, the on- and offshore industry, as well as in structures such as bridges, roofs, and mezzanine floors. 
Quality, craftsmanship, and enjoying our work are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we ensure strong structures and a strong team. 
What will you do as Production Manager? 
As Production Manager, you bear full responsibility for achieving production targets. You lead teams, optimize processes, and drive quality, safety, and efficiency. This is a role for a strong leader who provides direction, dares to make decisions, and impacts the company's overall performance. 
Your tasks in brief: - Daily organization, management, and coordination of production in the workshop - Monitoring the progress, quality, and budget of production orders - Identifying and resolving technical bottlenecks - Maintaining the machinery, lifting equipment, and tools - Ensuring a safe and structured work environment - Collaborating with the director on planning, procurement, work preparation, and optimization - Guiding, motivating, and developing your team - Administering work activities and reporting on progress - Continuously improving processes and work methods 
What do you bring to the table? - At least MBO+ level of professional education and thinking - Accurate, organized, flexible, and stress-resistant - Proven experience/knowledge in assembling and welding heavy steel structures - Proficiency in English and German - Leadership skills: you motivate your team and keep a cool head, even when things get tough - A flexible, results-oriented mindset

Your day-to-day responsibilities include: - Transport materials within the cleanroom and to airlocks - Support the transport of main bodies to airlocks and cabins - Check materials for quality, completeness, and correctness - Clean and pack modules according to procedures - Manage the lending and return of materials, tools, parts, and packaging - Load and unload goods using an EPT and support logistics processes
